{{Top|leg}}
'''Spot''' was the supposed "pet" of the used [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Vo Lantes]]. Spot was a regular feature in Vantes' [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] commercials. As a running gag, Spot's species changed from one unusual creature to the other.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives article">{{JournalCite|7|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref>
